# `app.graycard.scene.defs`

How a region is grounded onto the image plane. Covers the representations common in modern CV (detection, instance/panoptic segmentation, keypoints, oriented detection, 3D).

- **Source:** `lexicons/app/graycard/scene/defs.json`
- **Lexicon version:** `1`
- **Definitions:** 4

<a id="regionkind"></a>

## `regionKind`

How a region is grounded onto the image plane. Covers the representations common in modern CV (detection, instance/panoptic segmentation, keypoints, oriented detection, 3D).

**Kind:** `string`

**Resolved type:** `string`

**Known values:** `whole`, `bbox`, `rotated-bbox`, `polygon`, `multipolygon`, `mask`, `rle-mask`, `point`, `keypoints`, `contour`, `cuboid`, `depth-plane`, `other`

<a id="bbox"></a>

## `bbox`

Axis-aligned bounding box in normalized [0,1] coordinates scaled by 1,000,000 (origin top-left; x,y = top-left, w,h = size — COCO-style).

**Kind:** `object`

<a id="term"></a>

## `term`

A reference to a node or edge type declared in an ontology. Either an in-repo ontology term (ontology AT-URI + local id) or an external CURIE/URI.

**Kind:** `object`

### Resolved fields

Referenced object fields are expanded once. A linked type name opens the definition that supplies the field.

| Field      | Required | Type / resolved ref | Constraints     | Known values | Description                                                           |
| ---------- | -------- | ------------------- | --------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`       | yes      | `string`            | `maxLength=256` |              | Local term id within the ontology, a CURIE (e.g. wd:Q7378), or a URI. |
| `ontology` | no       | `string` (`at-uri`) |                 |              | app.graycard.scene.ontology declaring this term.                      |
| `label`    | no       | `string`            | `maxLength=256` |              | Human-readable label for the term (e.g. the Wikidata entity label).   |

<a id="rbox"></a>

## `rbox`

Rotated / oriented bounding box (OBB). Center + size in normalized [0,1] scaled by 1,000,000; angleDeg in degrees scaled by 1,000,000 (counter-clockwise).

**Kind:** `object`
